headline: TEX @ LAA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TEX 5.45 at LAA 3.43, with a projected total of 8.87. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TEX: TEX moved +0.90 runs while LAA moved +0.52, changing the projected margin by +0.38 runs. The projected total climbed +1.42, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -21.0%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: MacKenzie Gore has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Ezequiel Duran, Jake Burger, Nolan Schanuel, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Andrew McCutchen, Evan Carter because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
